description: Default architecture, no weight assignment (random init, ~0% accuracy).

v1 plus ~100 topic-noun keywords (person/place/number/entity/desc/abbrev) at tier 1; 6 classes.
v2 plus half-tier rules: 'what is the'/'what are the'->entity, 'name of'->entity.
